name: pinecone
description: Vector database access powered by the official Pinecone Developer MCP server — search Pinecone documentation, manage serverless indexes with integrated inference, upsert and semantically search records, rerank results, and run cascading queries across multiple indexes.

interface.shortDescription: Query and manage Pinecone vector indexes from the agent via the official MCP server.
interface.longDescription: The Pinecone skill exposes the official @pinecone-database/mcp server as a single Fractal toolset. It gives the agent first-class access to both the Pinecone documentation and the user's own serverless indexes with integrated inference. Capabilities include: searching the official Pinecone docs, listing and describing indexes, creating new indexes with a built-in embedding model (e.g. multilingual-e5-large, llama-text-embed-v2), upserting plain-text records, running semantic search with metadata filtering, reranking results with a dedicated reranker, and running cascading queries across multiple indexes with automatic deduplication. The single required configuration is PINECONE_API_KEY. Only indexes with integrated inference are supported; plain raw-vector serverless indexes, the Pinecone Assistant MCP, and the standalone embeddings API are out of scope for this server.
defaultPrompt: Use the Pinecone skill whenever the task involves querying, indexing, or managing data in a Pinecone vector database.
Always call `search-docs` first for any Pinecone-specific question — the official documentation is the source of truth.
Send plain text to upsert-records and search-records on indexes created with create-index-for-model — the integrated-inference pipeline owns embedding.
